# Version 3.119.4
> **Expanded platform support** · Released May 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.4)

> **Supersedes [3.119.3](3.119.3.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands native platform support and resolves rendering, lifetime, and platform integration failures. It adds GTK4 and Linux Bionic support, broadens Tizen and .NET Framework coverage, and rolls up the 3.119.3 preview fixes.

## Breaking Changes

- **Blazor integration changes** — The Blazor view package includes API changes in this release. Review the generated API diff and update affected view integration code before upgrading.

## Bug Fixes

- **Desktop and mobile rendering reliability improved** — Fixes address GTK4 Cairo assertion failures, Android MAUI SKGLView rendering after tab switches, and tvOS device and simulator native assets. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#3561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3561), [#3562](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3562), [#3563](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3563))
- **Stream lifetime behavior corrected** — SKManagedStream now retains an SKData snapshot rather than relying on a parent-child ownership chain. ([#3589](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3589))

## Platform

- **GTK4, Linux Bionic, Tizen, and .NET Framework support expanded** — Adds the GTK4 view package and Linux Bionic assets, builds Tizen for x64 and arm64, and adds a net48 target for Windows validation. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3527), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3631), [#3619](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3619))
- **Native loading is more robust** — D3D12 is delay-loaded to avoid startup failures on systems without DirectX 12, and the Linux linker now rejects unresolved native symbols. ([#3629](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3629), [#3633](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3633))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates libpng and includes the native hardening work first delivered in the 3.119.3 preview. — ❤️ [@sshumakov](https://github.com/sshumakov) ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478), [#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502), [#3723](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3723))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5

Includes the HarfBuzzSharp binding and native dependency updates carried forward from the 3.119.3 preview.
